verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל־ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al·mūṯ lab·bên miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ō·w·ḏeh Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lib·bî ’ă·sap·pə·rāh kāl- nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To [the tune of] “The Death of the Son A Psalm of David I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart I will recount all Your wonders

verses.original: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eś·mə·ḥāh wə·’e·‘el·ṣāh ḇāḵ ’ă·zam·mə·rāh šim·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: I will be glad and rejoice in You I will sing praise to Your name O Most High

verses.original: אוֹיְבַ֥י בְּשׁוּב־ אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wy·ḇay bə·šūḇ- ’ā·ḥō·wr yik·kā·šə·lū wə·yō·ḇə·ḏū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When my enemies retreat . . . they stumble and perish before You

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·pā·ṭî wə·ḏî·nî yā·šaḇ·tā lə·ḵis·sê šō·w·p̄êṭ ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: For You have upheld my just cause You sit on Your throne judging righteously

verses.original: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע מָ֝חִ֗יתָ שְׁמָ֥ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: gā·‘ar·tā ḡō·w·yim ’ib·baḏ·tā rā·šā‘ mā·ḥî·ṯā šə·mām lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: You have rebuked the nations You have destroyed the wicked You have erased their name forever and ever

verses.original: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב׀ תַּ֥מּוּ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח חֳרָב֗וֹת נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ וְעָרִ֥ים זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ אָבַ֖ד
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·w·yêḇ tam·mū lā·ne·ṣaḥ ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ nā·ṯaš·tā wə·‘ā·rîm ziḵ·rām hêm·māh ’ā·ḇaḏ
verses.literal: The enemy . . . has come to eternal ruin and You have uprooted their cities the very memory of them has vanished

verses.original: וַֽ֭יהוָה יֵשֵׁ֑ב לְעוֹלָ֣ם כּוֹנֵ֖ן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yê·šêḇ lə·‘ō·w·lām kō·w·nên kis·’ōw lam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: But the LORD abides forever He has established His throne for judgment

verses.original: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yiš·pōṭ- tê·ḇêl bə·ṣe·ḏeq yā·ḏîn lə·’um·mîm bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: He judges the world with justice He governs the people with equity

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה וִ֘יהִ֤י מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh wî·hî miś·gāḇ lad·dāḵ miś·gāḇ lə·‘it·tō·wṯ baṣ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed a stronghold in times of trouble

verses.original: יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ כִּ֤י יְהוָֽה׃ לֹֽא־ עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: yō·wḏ·‘ê šə·me·ḵā wə·yiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ḇə·ḵā kî Yah·weh lō- ‘ā·zaḇ·tā ḏō·rə·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Those who know Your name trust in You for You, O LORD have not forsaken those who seek You

verses.original: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh yō·šêḇ ṣî·yō·wn hag·gî·ḏū ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw ḇā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Sing praises to the LORD who dwells in Zion proclaim His deeds among the nations

verses.original: כִּֽי־ דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ח לֹֽא־ צַעֲקַ֥ת עֲנִיִּים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḏō·rêš dā·mîm ’ō·w·ṯām zā·ḵār šā·k̲aḥ lō·šā- ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ ʿă·nī·yīm
verses.literal: For the Avenger of bloodshed - remembers He does not ignore . . . the cry of the afflicted

verses.original: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י עָ֭נְיִי מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nə·nê·nî Yah·weh rə·’êh miś·śō·nə·’āy ‘ā·nə·yî mə·rō·wm·mî miš·ša·‘ă·rê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD see how my enemies afflict me Lift me up from the gates of death

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל־ תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־ צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’ă·sap·pə·rāh kāl- tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā bə·ša·‘ă·rê ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn ’ā·ḡî·lāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: that I may declare all Your praises that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation

verses.original: ג֭וֹיִם טָבְע֣וּ בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ רַגְלָֽם׃ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ
verses.transliteration: ḡō·w·yim ṭā·ḇə·‘ū bə·ša·ḥaṯ ‘ā·śū raḡ·lām nil·kə·ḏāh bə·re·šeṯ- zū ṭā·mā·nū
verses.literal: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making their feet are caught in the net . . . they have hidden

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ נ֤וֹדַ֨ע׀ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע נוֹקֵ֣שׁ בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nō·w·ḏa‘ miš·pāṭ ‘ā·śāh rā·šā‘ nō·w·qêš bə·p̄ō·‘al kap·pāw hig·gā·yō·wn se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD is known by the justice He brings the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands Higgaion Selah

verses.original: רְשָׁעִ֣ים יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל־ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rə·šā·‘îm yā·šū·ḇū liš·’ō·w·lāh kāl- gō·w·yim šə·ḵê·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The wicked will return to Sheol all the nations who forget God

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶבְי֑וֹן לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח תִּקְוַ֥ת עֲנָוִים לָעַֽד׃ תֹּאבַ֥ד
verses.transliteration: kî ’eḇ·yō·wn lō lā·ne·ṣaḥ yiš·šā·ḵaḥ tiq·waṯ ʿă·nå̄·wīm lā·‘aḏ tō·ḇaḏ
verses.literal: For the needy {will} not always be forgotten nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יָעֹ֣ז ג֝וֹיִ֗ם יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ עַל־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh ’al- ’ĕ·nō·wōš yā·‘ōz ḡō·w·yim yiš·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Rise up O LORD do not let man prevail let the nations be judged in Your presence

verses.original: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה מוֹרָ֗ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ גוֹיִ֑ם יֵדְע֥וּ לָ֫הֶ֥ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯāh mō·w·rāh Yah·weh ḡō·w·yim yê·ḏə·‘ū lā·hem ’ĕ·nō·wōš hêm·māh se·lāh
verses.literal: Lay terror upon them, [O LORD] let the nations know they are but men . . . Selah
